content.explanation: Netscape viewed browser tasks in two categories: heavy computation and lightweight interactions. JavaScript was created as a glue language that connects buttons, forms, events, and business logic. It acts as the communication layer that ties user interfaces to application behavior.
content.example: A button click triggers JavaScript, which then executes business logic.
content.analogy: Glue holds different parts together without being the object itself.

mcqs.question: Why was a glue language needed?
A form triggers validation after typing. What role is JavaScript playing?
JavaScript was created to replace Java.
mcqs.explanation: It was created to complement it.
